title: 上海机场国庆假日返程交通提示
publisher: 上海市人民政府（上海发布）
claims: Pudong Airport is served by Metro Line 2 (Pudong Airport station) from 06:00 to 22:30 and by the Maglev between Pudong Airport and Longyang Road from 07:02 to 21:42, and from Longyang Road to Pudong Airport from 06:45 to 21:40.

Pudong Airport airport buses include Line 4 to Shanghai Railway Station North Square (07:00-23:00), Line 7 to Shanghai South Railway Station (07:30-23:00), and an overnight service to Hongqiao Transport Hub East (23:00-05:30).
Hongqiao Airport is served by Metro Line 2 at Terminal 2 and Line 10 at Terminals 1 and 2, both 06:00-22:30.
The city airport line runs from Hongqiao Terminal 2 from 05:45 to 22:00 about every 15 minutes.
Airport Line 1 connects Hongqiao Transport Hub East with Pudong Airport from 06:00 to 23:00.
Both airports publish parking and taxi or ride-hailing pickup areas.
